question.text: In the esterification <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>⇌</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>+</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> an equimolar mixture of alcohol and acid taken initially yields under equilibrium, the water with mole fraction = 0.333. The equilibrium constant is.

solution.text:
As alcohol and acid are equimolar so the initial concentration would also be same. Suppose the initial concentration is 'C'.

xC-x+C-x+x+x=0.33=13
3x=2C
x=2C3
Kc=2C3×2C3C-2C3×C-2C3=4
